title: Add QR code tracking for Beacon Holiday Market flyers
body: Dana Whitfield is printing flyers for the Beacon Holiday Market (Dec 12-13). Add a `?src=beacon` parameter to the flyer QR link and count visits, so we can tell how many people came from the market.

title: Swap in final label art once red vs navy is decided
body: The hero currently uses the red palette. When the owner picks between Priya Raman's red (snowy river) and navy proofs, update `styles.css` and add the label illustration to the hero.
